frontcowl.name: Front cowl
frontcowl.desc: Front body over the steering and front fork. Daily: safety interlocks, engine oil (SAE 30), hydraulic fluid level cold, tyre pressure, hoses for leaks.

steering.name: Steering (mechanical box)
steering.desc: The 3040 has a MECHANICAL steering box 107-3526, not hydraulic steering. If steering is stiff or has play: check the box (backlash, shims 108-8442, bearings 38-7820), the steering shaft and the fork bearings 107-7589 / 107-7590 (2 of each). Grease the steering pivot every 100 h (flush fitting needs adapter 107-1998). Tag out if steering is not right.

seat.name: Seat and seat switch
seat.desc: Seat switch is part of the safety interlocks. Original Sand Pro seats are obsolete (bulletin 02-19): replacements come as seat kits. Replace the neutral and seat interlock switches every 1500 h.

rearhood.name: Engine (Briggs & Stratton V-twin)
rearhood.desc: B&S 305447-0285-G2 (Toro 120-3402), 2 plugs. Oil 1.66 L SAE 30 (API SL+). Oil and filter 107-7817 at 20 h then every 100 h. Air filter 108-3811 every 200 h (replace, do not clean). Every 800 h: plugs Champion RC14YC 0.76 mm 23 N.m, in-line fuel filter 94-2690, valve adjust and decarbon. Clean the cooling fins and oil cooler. Scott (Toro) serviced it at 988 h on 14 Oct 2026: rocker cover gasket refitted and dipstick tube seal 693172 changed to stop oil leaks.

frame.name: Frame, hydraulics and rear hitch
frame.desc: Hydraulic reservoir 18.9 L Toro Premium All Season (or ISO VG 46 anti-wear). Hydraulic filter 54-0110 at 8 h, then every 400 h with the fluid. Grease the rear hitch (5 fittings) and traction-pedal pivot every 100 h. Lift cylinder 115-5647 seal kit 108-4597. Replace moving hoses every 1500 h.

fork.name: Front fork and wheel motor
fork.desc: Grease the front wheel bearing every 100 h. Wheel motor seal kit 110-6459.

tyreF.name: Front tyre
tyreF.desc: Knobby 2-ply 85-8290 (wheel and tyre 95-0621). 70 kPa (10 psi) treaded; smooth tyres 55-70 kPa. Lug nuts 95-122 N.m at 8 h and every 100 h.

tyreR.name: Rear tyres (left and right)
tyreR.desc: Same tyre and pressure as the front. Lug nuts 95-122 N.m. Wheel motor seal kit 110-6459.

battery.name: 12 V battery
battery.desc: Toro 104-8162. Check cable connections and electrolyte every 25 h.

rake.name: Rear rake attachment
rake.desc: Tooth rake carbide tine pack 119-2152. Check the hitch pins and grease the hitch every 100 h.

fenders.name: Rear fenders
fenders.desc: Moulded rear fenders over the rear tyres, one each side of the seat.

fenderR.name: Rear fender (right)
fenderR.desc: Same moulding as the left fender, on the right side.

tyreRR.name: Rear tyre (right)
tyreRR.desc: Same tyre and pressure as the front. Lug nuts 95-122 N.m. Wheel motor seal kit 110-6459.

107-1998.name: Grease adapter for the steering pivot flush fitting

693172.name: Dipstick tube seal (grommet)
693172.note: Changed by Scott (Toro) 14 Oct 2026 at 988 h.

model.note: Part outlines are traced from Toro's product photo of the Sand Pro 3040 (rear view) and are approximate; the front fork, battery and rake attachments are not in this view and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from parts catalog 3422-648 and operator's manual 3422-632 (s/n 402940001 and up, covers this unit). Engine parts beyond filters and plugs come through Briggs & Stratton.

107-7589 / 107-7590: Steering fork bearings (cone with seal / cup)
107-7817: Toro dealer (Amacron / GA Power Equipment Spares / Emmetts)
Champion RC14YC: Auto/small-engine parts stores or Toro dealer
44957: MVP 1000 h kit (10x oil filter, 5x air filter, 2x fuel filter, 1x 115-7854, 1x hyd filter)
